LightningComponentBundle.description: Per-Quote-Line table: clickable line, product, editable Custom vs Standard picklist, live Revenue Recognition Type per row.

propertyType.name: T
propertyType.label: Quote Line Object
propertyType.description: The object your quote line collection is built from, e.g. SBQQ__QuoteLine__c

property.name: quoteLines
property.label: Quote Lines
property.description: Record collection variable from a Get Records element (Quote Lines for this Quote).

property.name: quoteLineObjectApiName
property.label: Quote Line Object API Name
property.description: e.g. SBQQ__QuoteLine__c

property.name: customVsStandardFieldApiName
property.label: Custom vs Standard Field API Name
property.description: The picklist field API name on the Quote Line object.

property.name: productNameFieldApiName
property.label: Product Name Field API Name
property.description: A text/formula field on the Quote Line holding the related Product's name (relationship fields can't be traversed generically).

property.name: revenueRecognitionTypeFieldApiName
property.label: Revenue Recognition Type Field API Name
property.description: Field on the Quote Line that stores the saved/computed result, e.g. Revenue_Recognition_Type__c

property.name: productTypeFieldApiName
property.label: Product Type Field API Name (Quote Line)
property.description: Field on the Quote Line that stores the Revenue Category answer, e.g. Revenue_Type__c. Leave blank to skip saving it per line.

property.name: agreementTypeFieldApiName
property.label: Agreement Type Field API Name (Quote Line)
property.description: Field on the Quote Line that stores the Agreement Type answer. Leave blank to skip saving it per line.

property.name: rrtUpdateFieldApiName
property.label: RRT Update Source Field API Name (Quote Line)
property.description: Picklist field that flags whether the saved Revenue Recognition Type came from history (Automatic) or a person (Manual). Used to decide when to warn before overwriting. Leave blank to disable the confirmation warning entirely.

property.name: rightToCostFieldApiName
property.label: Right to Cost Field API Name (Quote Line)
property.description: Field on the Quote Line that stores the Right to Cost + Profit Upon Cancellation answer. Leave blank to skip saving it per line.

property.name: Product_Type
property.label: Product Type (Revenue Category)
property.description: Maps to Flow variable: Product_Type. Bind the header screen component's own value to this SAME variable (not a separate one) so a cancelled override can push the reverted value back to it. Requires the screen to be reactive.

property.name: Agreement_Type
property.label: Agreement Type
property.description: Maps to Flow variable: Agreement_Type. Bind the header screen component's own value to this SAME variable so a cancelled override can push the reverted value back to it. Requires the screen to be reactive.

property.name: Right_to_Cost_Profit_Upon_Cancellation
property.label: Right to Cost + Profit Upon Cancellation
property.description: Maps to Flow variable: Right_to_Cost_Profit_Upon_Cancellation. Bind the header screen component's own value to this SAME variable so a cancelled override can push the reverted value back to it. Requires the screen to be reactive.

property.name: MSA_LTSA_Reference
property.label: MSA / LTSA Reference
property.description: Maps to Flow variable: MSA_LTSA_Reference (or Get_Existing_Quote.MSA_LTSA_Reference__c). Used only to also save this value onto each Quote Line.

property.name: msaLtsaFieldApiName
property.label: MSA / LTSA Reference Field API Name (Quote Line)
property.description: Field on the Quote Line that stores the MSA / LTSA Reference. Leave blank to skip saving it per line.

property.name: quoteLineProductIdFieldApiName
property.label: Product Lookup Field API Name (Quote Line) [Unused]
property.description: No longer used by the component (product-based Custom vs Standard defaulting was removed). Kept only so older Flow versions that still reference it can deploy.

property.name: productObjectApiName
property.label: Product Object API Name [Unused]
property.description: No longer used by the component. Kept only so older Flow versions that still reference it can deploy.

property.name: productIsStandardFieldApiName
property.label: Is Standard Field API Name (Product) [Unused]
property.description: No longer used by the component. Kept only so older Flow versions that still reference it can deploy.

property.name: cvsSourceFieldApiName
property.label: Custom vs Standard Source Field API Name (Quote Line) [Unused]
property.description: No longer used by the component. Kept only so older Flow versions that still reference it can deploy.

property.name: editedQuoteLines
property.label: Quote Lines to Save
property.description: Every Quote Line row, each stamped with Custom vs Standard, computed Revenue Recognition Type, and the mapped header answers. Feed this into an Update Records element.

property.name: hasInvalidRows
property.label: Has Invalid Rows
property.description: True if any row is an invalid combination. Also enforced by built-in Next/Finish validation.

property.name: hasManualOverride
property.label: Has Manual Override
property.description: True if any row's value differs from what was loaded (a real change happened this session). Use this to flag the parent Quote as Manual when any of its lines changed.
